title: Wedding Invitation Bundle: 5 Styles, 15 Editable PPTX Designs with Details, RSVP and Mobile Versions
description:
I designed this coordinated stationery collection so you can choose a wedding style and personalize a complete invitation suite at your own pace.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE
Five styles: Minimal, Woodland, Glamour, Vintage and Urban. Each includes an invitation, details card and RSVP card: 15 distinct designs. Matching 9:16 mobile adaptations are included; they are size adaptations of the same designs.

FILES
10 editable PPTX files, three slides each: five print files and five mobile files.
10 sample PDFs showing those same 30 pages.
15 mobile sample JPGs at 1080 x 1920 pixels, with example names and dates.
Quick-start, editing instructions and personal-use license.

PERSONALIZE YOUR EVENT
Replace the example names, date, ceremony and reception times, venue, address, dress code and website. Text boxes, lines and borders are editable. Woodland botanical artwork is a fixed background image. Print and mobile files are edited separately. Longer names or wording may require manual resizing.

SIZES & COMPATIBILITY
Print: 5 x 7 inches, portrait. Mobile: 9:16. English sample wording. PPTX import and PDF export tested in LibreOffice Impress; native Microsoft PowerPoint, Keynote and Canva import have not been tested. No Canva template link, account, subscription or font files are supplied. Times New Roman and Arial are specified; substitute compatible fonts if needed and recheck layout.

PDF text/linework are vector-based. Botanical background is 1060 x 1484 original pixels (approximately 212 PPI at 5 x 7 inches), not native 4K. Print samples before a full print run. No bleed, crop marks or imposed sheets. Gold-tone lines are flat color, not metallic foil.

HOW TO DOWNLOAD
Download the ZIP directly from your Etsy purchases and unzip it. Open a working copy of the chosen PPTX, personalize, export and proofread. PDF and JPG samples are filled examples, not editable form fields. A JPG cannot collect RSVPs; your own wedding website or response form is required and is not included.

LICENSE & IMPORTANT DETAILS
Personal use for one private wedding, with copies for your guests. No template resale, public source-file sharing or commercial client use. This is a digital product: no printed cards, envelopes, frames, props, printing service or seller customization is included. Preview watermarks are absent from buyer files.

The watercolor botanical artwork was created with AI assistance and incorporated into my stationery designs. Promotional styling is illustrative; the full-content overview shows the real layouts.

Please message Pinogri through Etsy if you need help accessing your download.
